newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI Oct-Dec 1996 net 78.656 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: ATI Oct-Dec 1996 net 78.656 mln pesos.

text.p: Port operator Asian Terminals Inc (ATI) said on Friday it made a net income of 78.656 million pesos in the quarter ended December 31, the second quarter of its 1996-97 fiscal year.
It told the Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission that income from the operations of its grains and container port at the Manila south harbour reached 73.068 million pesos.
It said its new grains terminal at Mariveles, Bataan near Manila contributed 5.588 million pesos in net income.
Gross revenues of the firm in the period reached 536.716 million pesos, ATI said.
The company did not give comparative figures.
